title: Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
abstract: arXiv:2610.40535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost.   In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later rest

translated_title: 通过回溯实现高效的可扩展监督
translated_abstract: 可扩展监督探讨的是一个较弱的验证者如何检验由更强大的AI系统执行的计算输出。一种被提出的方法使用了相对化交互式证明，其中较弱的验证者通过与一个或多个强大的证明者交互，来检验复杂的预言机辅助计算的输出。一个突出的例子是辩论，它非常高效，但假设两个强大的AI模型（即证明者）之一是诚实的。对于某些类别的预言机辅助计算，这一假设可以被去除，但代价是计算成本大幅增加。在这项工作中，我们引入了可回溯交互式证明（RIPs），这是一种用于可扩展监督的新型相对化交互式证明模型。在RIP中，验证者可以将证明者回溯到交互过程中较早的状态，并从该状态继续交互。当证明者是AI模型时，这是可行的，因为验证者可以保存模型状态的快照，并在之后恢复到该状态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了可回溯交互式证明（RIPs）这一新型可扩展监督模型，其中较弱的验证者可以通过将AI证明者回溯到交互的早期状态来高效检验强大AI系统的计算输出，从而在无需假设证明者诚实的前提下实现高效监督。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces rewindable interactive proofs (RIPs), a new scalable oversight model in which a weak verifier can efficiently check the outputs of computations by powerful AI systems by rewinding the AI prover to earlier states of the interaction, achieving efficient oversight without assuming prover honesty.
